_readme: Legitimate exceptions to tools/consistency-check.mjs. Every entry needs a reason. rule = rule id, pages = glob or list (default *), match = substring of the finding (optional). Add an entry only when the text is correct and the rule is wrong for it. Never allowlist to hide a real inconsistency.
